%% cvforge-template v1
%% sections: experience, projects, skills, education
%% supports: person.phone, person.links, experience.location, projects.url
%% max-bullets-per-role: 5
%% engine: xelatex
%
% Deedy Resume, OpenFonts version (Apache-2.0, Debarghya Das), converted to the cvforge contract.
% The class, its fonts (Lato, Raleway, loaded from fonts/ by relative Path) and its two-column
% minipage layout are the original's. The original sample .tex could not be fetched in this
% environment (see LICENSE-NOTE.md); this body uses the class's own macros in the published
% layout: a narrow left column (education, skills) and a wide right column (experience,
% projects).
\documentclass[]{deedy-resume-openfont}

\begin{document}

\namesection{\VAR{person.name.split(' ')[0]}}{\VAR{person.name.split(' ')[1:]|join(' ')}}{
\BLOCK{for link in person.links}\href{\VAR{link.href}}{\VAR{link.text}} | \BLOCK{endfor}\href{mailto:\VAR{person.email}}{\VAR{person.email}}\BLOCK{if person.phone} | \VAR{person.phone}\BLOCK{endif}

}

%----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	COLUMN ONE
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.33\textwidth}

\section{Education}
\BLOCK{for ed in education}
\subsection{\VAR{ed.org}}
\descript{\VAR{ed.degree}}
\location{\BLOCK{if ed.start}\VAR{ed.start} -- \BLOCK{endif}\VAR{ed.end}}
\sectionsep
\BLOCK{endfor}

\section{Skills}
\BLOCK{for s in skills}
\VAR{s} \\
\BLOCK{endfor}
\sectionsep

\end{minipage}
\hfill
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	COLUMN TWO
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.66\textwidth}

\section{Experience}
\BLOCK{for job in experience}
\runsubsection{\VAR{job.org}}
\descript{| \VAR{job.title}}
\location{\VAR{job.start} -- \VAR{job.end}\BLOCK{if job.location} | \VAR{job.location}\BLOCK{endif}}
\BLOCK{if job.bullets}
\vspace{\topsep} % Hacky fix for awkward extra vertical space (as in the original sample)
\begin{tightemize}
\BLOCK{for b in job.bullets}
\item \VAR{b.text} % id:\VAR{b.id}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{tightemize}
\BLOCK{endif}
\sectionsep
\BLOCK{endfor}

\section{Projects}
\BLOCK{for p in projects}
\runsubsection{\VAR{p.name}}
\descript{\BLOCK{if p.url}| \VAR{p.url}\BLOCK{endif}}
\BLOCK{if p.bullets}
\begin{tightemize}
\BLOCK{for b in p.bullets}
\item \VAR{b.text} % id:\VAR{b.id}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{tightemize}
\BLOCK{endif}
\sectionsep
\BLOCK{endfor}

\end{minipage}
\end{document}
